items.quote: The old prophet answered, “I too am a prophet, as you are. And an angel said to me by the word of the Lord: ‘Bring him back with you to your house so that he may eat bread and drink water.’” (But he was lying to him.)
items.contrast: The old prophet is the liar; the man of God is the person being deceived.
items.reason: The parenthetical comment refers back to the old prophet’s speech, so “he” is the old prophet and “him” is the man of God. Resolving those pronouns requires distinguishing the actor from the recipient.
